# Offline QR encoder

The SharePass wrapper in `sharepass-qr.js` bundles the QRCode for JavaScript modules distributed in the `qrcode-terminal` 0.12.0 `vendor/QRCode` directory. The encoder is local to the app. No QR service or CDN is used. The original QRCode for JavaScript core credits Kazuhiko Arase, copyright 2009. See the [upstream package](https://github.com/gtanner/qrcode-terminal) and the included [license notices](QR-LICENSE.txt).

Preserve square SVG modules, black on white contrast and the four-module quiet zone. WhatsApp links and QR images open a draft. The sender reviews and sends it in WhatsApp.
